propositions: AcliClient._search_cache memoizes JQL results without TTL or invalidation, caching negative (empty) answers permanently across multiple caller requests
Clients that re-issue the same JQL query on a single AcliClient instance receive stale cached answers instead of fresh Jira results, causing missed index-visibility polls (bug d30c)
The cache lifetime is undocumented and unenforced, with only two call sites working around it via private attribute reach-in (access_check.py and _fresh_search)
Per-pass client construction (one client per reconcile pass) establishes a natural cache lifetime boundary that should be documented and enforced via public API
invalidate_search_cache(jql=None) method must support per-JQL eviction and full cache clear, replacing all private reach-in patterns
